compatible rollback retains interrupted denominator and reset archives earlier results

history cap never prunes and keyboard reset restores baseline focus
a named reset control cannot shadow the prototype form reset
twenty prior reset runs are retained; full archive rejects reset without pruning

actual missing-model asset failure is visible, controls safe and reload/reset recover
no unexpected page exceptions or HTTP/WebSocket requests
